description: Small Ralph self-iteration focused on restoring fresh main/branch CI health for OSv2 service and upper-layer experience work. The latest main CI run after the prior self-iteration merge fails in both Go race coverage and full web Vitest coverage, so this PRD prioritizes deterministic CI blockers before adding capability work.

userStories.name: Make audit and LDAP schedulers race-clean in Go CI
userStories.description: The fresh main CI Go job fails under `go test ./... -race -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic` with data races in the audit root-hash publisher scheduler and LDAP sync scheduler. Fix the scheduler lifecycle synchronization so Stop can safely run while the goroutine is selecting, and keep the immediate-run behavior needed for audit anchoring and identity sync dogfood paths.
bdd_acceptance: Given the audit root-hash publisher scheduler is running, When Stop is called while the goroutine is selecting for cancellation, Then the race detector reports no concurrent access to scheduler stop state.
Given the LDAP sync scheduler is running, When Stop is called while the goroutine is selecting for cancellation, Then the race detector reports no concurrent access to scheduler stop state.

Given the audit scheduler immediate cycle publishes yesterday's root hash, When the test observes the first cycle, Then the observation uses synchronized test state rather than racing with the scheduler goroutine.
ci_evidence: GitHub CI run 26021737712 on 2026-05-18 failed Go / Test (with race + coverage).
CI log: `TestRootHashPublisher_Scheduler_RunsImmediateCycle` failed with a race between `RootHashPublisher.Stop` writing `stopCh` and `Start.func1` selecting on `p.stopCh`.
CI log: `TestScheduler_RunsImmediatelyAndStops` failed with a race between `LDAPSyncScheduler.Stop` writing `stopCh` and `Start.func1` selecting on `s.stopCh`.
Local red on 2026-05-18: `go test -race ./pkg/audit -run TestRootHashPublisher_Scheduler_RunsImmediateCycle -count=1 -v` failed with races on `chainStoreStub.calls` and scheduler `stopCh`.
Local red on 2026-05-18: `go test -race ./pkg/auth -run TestScheduler_RunsImmediatelyAndStops -count=1 -v` failed with a race on scheduler `stopCh`.

userStories.name: Isolate Sidebar dataset admin nav in full Vitest coverage
userStories.description: The fresh main Web CI job fails only in the full `npx vitest run --coverage` suite: `Sidebar.test.tsx` reaches dataset-scoped Query Builder links but cannot find the admin `Object Types` link. Targeted sidebar coverage passes locally, so this story should root-cause full-suite state or MSW isolation and keep dataset rollback admin navigation stable.
bdd_acceptance: Given `/admin/datasets/:dataset/rollback` is rendered for an admin user, When the sidebar derives the active ontology from `:dataset`, Then Query Builder, Quiver TS, and Object Types links all target that dataset.
Given the Sidebar spec runs inside the full coverage suite after unrelated auth tests, When `/api/v2/me` is mocked as admin, Then prior tests cannot hide the admin section.
Given targeted sidebar coverage runs, When only `Sidebar.test.tsx` executes, Then it still passes without weakening the full-suite guard.
Full web Vitest coverage passes or the isolated full-suite reproduction passes with the fixed ordering.
ci_evidence: GitHub CI run 26021737712 on 2026-05-18 failed Web / Vitest (with coverage).

CI log: `src/components/layout/__tests__/Sidebar.test.tsx > Sidebar admin section > treats :dataset route param as active ontology on dataset routes` failed with `Unable to find an element with the text: Object Types`.
CI log summary: 1 failed file, 262 passed files, 1 failed test, 2780 passed tests.
Local targeted run on 2026-05-18: `cd web && npx vitest run src/components/layout/__tests__/Sidebar.test.tsx --coverage` passed 10 tests, so the failure is full-suite or ordering-sensitive.

userStories.name: Make heavyweight Go performance gates CI-safe under race coverage
userStories.description: After the scheduler races, the same fresh Go CI run still shows race/coverage-hostile performance and scale tests timing out or missing tight wall-clock budgets. Keep the OSv2 query, security, aggregation, and export confidence checks valuable while making them safe for CI's `-race -coverprofile` environment.
bdd_acceptance: Given CI runs Go tests with `-race -coverprofile`, When aggregation precision and speed checks run, Then they avoid 10-minute package timeouts while still validating approximate distinct accuracy at a meaningful scale.

Given CI runs Go tests with `-race -coverprofile`, When cell security and RLS performance checks run, Then budget assertions account for race/coverage overhead or move strict budgets to non-race benchmarks.
Given CI runs Go tests with `-race -coverprofile`, When XLSX streaming large-file coverage runs, Then it validates memory behavior without timing out the package.
Targeted package tests pass under the same race/coverage flags used by CI.
ci_evidence: GitHub CI run 26021737712 showed `TestUS376_PerfGate_1000Rows_10Columns_Under50ms` taking 123.820824ms against a 50ms budget under race coverage.

GitHub CI run 26021737712 showed `TestApproximateDistinct_OneMillion_FasterThanExactByFiveX` speedup 3.01x against a 5x budget and `TestApproximateDistinct_OneMillion_HLL_P99Under2Percent` timing out after 10m.
GitHub CI run 26021737712 showed `TestRLSEvaluator_PerformanceGate` cold and warm passes exceeding 500ms / 50ms budgets under race coverage.
GitHub CI run 26021737712 showed `TestWriter_LargeFileMemoryBudget` timing out after 10m in `pkg/xlsxstream`.
